security_spec.violation_condition: When QEMU implements the tile punning scheme (mapping tile elements across TEW=8/16/32/64 views of the shared 16*TE*TE byte matrix state) with an incorrect offset calculation in the punning() algorithm, a guest write using one TEW followed by a read using a different TEW returns data from the wrong physical element location, causing cross-TEW-view data aliasing that violates the architecturally mandated punning layout.
security_spec.summary: Incorrect QEMU emulation of the mandated tile punning layout (cross-TEW aliasing of shared 16*TE*TE byte matrix state) causes guest data written via one TEW view to be misread via another TEW view, leaking stale or cross-domain tile contents
